clips.hook: Tried to pet a gator in GTA 6
clips.title: Lacy tried to make friends with a gator in GTA 6…
clips.caption: Rule one of Leonida: do not pet the gator 🐊
clips.voice_intro: Lacy spots a gator in the swamp and decides it looks friendly.
clips.voice_outro: Easily the most Florida thing to happen in a video game. Trying to befriend the gator was a bold choice.
